text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон stuns the crowd with a
breathtaking
run. Slowly but surely,
people are beginning to
recognize her
for her skills.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, there's no doubt Нарита Брайан
will win
the second crown, and Hishi
Amazon can't afford
to fall behind. Our
next challenge will be the
Shuka Sho!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
